ideas.pitch: A localized, multilingual AI assistant focused on regional health awareness, symptom triage, and vaccination tracking tailored for semi-urban communities in Maharashtra.
ideas.title: CortexCare: Multilingual Health Awareness AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the social-impact pattern from SAGACITY, which won first prize by solving a concrete, regional public health communication gap that appeals directly to an industry panel.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutrition platform generating personalized meal plans and insights optimized specifically for traditional Indian household ingredients and dietary habits.
ideas.title: NutriTrack AI: Regional Diet Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant, tailoring the use-case to local food ecosystems which resonates with a domestic industry panel.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined, AI-assisted platform providing a fully digital, branch-like guided application experience for micro-entrepreneur and student loan applicants.
ideas.title: FinApply: Digital Branch Loan Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the financial-inclusion strategy seen in CapitalCue, providing clear economic utility and a polished user journey that scores exceptionally well in 7-minute presentations.

ideas.pitch: An interactive, narrative-driven visual novel game teaching urban students about water scarcity, smart conservation technologies, and daily accountability.
ideas.title: HydroEducate: Water Conservation Visual Novel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the gamified education approach of AquaQuest, standing out instantly among a sea of standard CRUD web applications during offline panel judging in Pune.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence and retrieval platform that transforms raw recorded meetings and surveillance clips into fully searchable, indexed knowledge bases.
ideas.title: VideoSearch: Unstructured Enterprise Data Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the technical depth of LibrAI, addressing hard engineering problems in multimodal retrieval that capture the attention of technical industry judges.
